title: Rule of Three
description: Solve direct proportions with a simple rule-of-three calculator.
metaDescription: Solve simple rule of three online for direct proportions.

form.title: Calculate rule of three
form.description: Enter three values for the proportion A is to B as C is to X.

seo.about: Direct rule of three solves proportions where A is to B as C is to X.
seo.howToUse: Fill A, B, and C. The tool calculates X using X = B × C ÷ A.
